settings.label: Enable auto-align time slots
settings.section: Auto-align time slots Align available time slots with service duration to prevent booking conflicts
settings.help: When enabled, customers will only see time slots aligned with the service duration. For example, a 2-hour service will show slots every 2 hours (09:00, 11:00, 13:00...) instead of every 15 minutes. This prevents customers from booking at misaligned times that would block optimal scheduling.
